race.comment: ROYAL OVERTURE (8) has the clearest recent race form after missing by a nose at Gundagai, where she was sent out favourite and still had to deal with being held up around the home turn. Her Wangaratta third prior also came with traffic at a key stage, so she looks ready to convert. SHE'S ASTUNNERARCH (9) resumes with a Pakenham trial win behind her and her Wangaratta third last campaign, beaten just under a length, reads well enough for this. She should run well for the Hayes yard. VALIANT DREAMER (10) has been costly, including when favourite at Goulburn, yet her Newcastle fourth beaten a length and subsequent trial now with Matt Laurie has her firmly in contention. I'M GOOD (3) is the debut runner with first-time blinkers and a close Wangaratta trial second, she draws for every hope. JEZEBEL JENNI (4) has minor claims.
